entity.description: Located steps from Gulf Shores Beach in the new Embassy Suites Resort, Sound Wave combines daily live music, Gulf views, and an energetic atmosphere. This open-air, second-floor venue is the ultimate destination for concerts and live performances in Gulf Shores, featuring a state-of-the-art sound system and an extensive food and drink menu. Whether you're here for the music, the Gulf views, or the lively vibe, The Sound Wave is where the coast comes to life. Daily Live music Monday - Sunday.

welcome to
SOUND WAVE

Perched above the shoreline, our beach bar in Gulf Shores brings together live music, coastal cocktails, and laid-back energy with unbeatable views. Whether you’re here for sunset drinks, weekend bands, or a casual night out with friends, this is where the vibe turns up.

Sip frozen favorites, signature craft cocktails, and local brews while the music sets the tone. From daytime chill to after-dark beats, every night feels like summer.

No reservations required. Just good drinks, good music, and Gulf Shores energy.

	
“BEACH EATS + SHAREABLE MOMENTS”

From ahi tuna nachos to seafood towers stacked with shrimp, grouper & lobster, our menu is built for sharing, snacking, and chilling by the water. Fresh, fun, and full of Gulf Coast flavor.

VIEW MENUS
	
WHAT'S ON

Join us for our weekly entertainment and a variety of other exciting events, offering something fun for everyone to enjoy!

THE SOUNDWAVE EXPERIENCE

Soundwave is a rooftop bar in Gulf Shores offering beachfront views, craft cocktails, and live music in an elevated coastal setting. Located just steps from the sand, Soundwave blends sunset energy, fresh Gulf air, and a vibrant nightlife atmosphere.

Whether you're visiting for vacation, meeting friends for rooftop drinks, or planning a celebration, Soundwave delivers an unforgettable beachside experience above it all.

	
OUR PHILOSOPHY

At Sound Wave, the experience is everything. As a rooftop bar in Gulf Shores, we bring together handcrafted cocktails, live music, and beachfront views to create an atmosphere that feels both elevated and effortlessly coastal.

From golden-hour sunsets to high-energy nights, Sound Wave is designed for gathering, celebrating, and soaking in the rhythm of the shore.

Our rooftop lounge offers open-air seating and panoramic views of the Gulf Shores, perfect for sunset cocktails, live music, and private celebrations above the beach.  

THE EXPERIENCE
rooftop views. live music. coastal energy.

From golden-hour sunsets to high-energy nights, Sound Wave delivers a rooftop experience unlike anywhere else in Gulf Shores. With live music, handcrafted cocktails, and panoramic beachfront views, every visit feels elevated yet effortlessly coastal.

Whether you're meeting friends for sunset drinks or staying late for the music, Sound Wave brings together the rhythm of the shore and the energy of Gulf Shores nightlife.

	
VISIT US

We invite you to come and experience the unique charm of our restaurant. Whether you are a regular guest or visiting for the first time, we look forward to welcoming you and making your time with us delightful and memorable.
